description: Page counts per state per corpus tier. Not a suite output — verified by directly counting pages in the source PDFs with PyMuPDF, re-verified 2026-08-16 (see paper/results/task1_20260816/manifest.json -> corpus_pages_verified).
verification_command: python -c "import fitz; print(fitz.open(path).page_count)"  # run once per PDF under standards/
notes: CO has no single 'full' page count: the birth-to-8 document is 187pp, the 3-5-only document is 41pp; the _only_subset (10pp) and _trimmed (41pp) tiers both derive from the 3-5 document.
CA has no _trimmed tier — its full (68pp) PTKLF 'at a glance' document was cut directly to the 13pp _only_subset.
The held-out canary is NV-2023 (nevada_standards_2023_only_subset.pdf, multi-domain), not NV-SES-2025 (single-domain, too narrow for a generalization claim).
All current eval numbers in paper/results/task{1,2}_20260816/ are from the _only_subset tier only — no table anywhere in this paper may present them as full-document numbers (guardrail 1).
